run_simulation: run the pybullet manyspheres simulation with 1000 spheres in a 10x10x10 grid
connect_pybullet: connect to the pybullet physics simulator using shared memory or GUI mode
load_urdf_models: load URDF models like planes, trays, and spheres into the pybullet simulation
configure_gravity: configure gravity using interactive debug parameters for X, Y, and Z axes
set_physics_parameters: set physics engine parameters like solver iterations and contact breaking threshold
